counterfactuals.description: single-source and multi-source presentations whose AGGREGATE cue / target semantics are controlled to be identical; the question is whether a strategy difference that must be preserved still exists.
counterfactuals.question: When aggregate cue / target semantics are equal, is there a residual, player-relevant strategy difference between single-source and multi-source presentations that must be preserved in Response?
counterfactuals.decision_rule: Only a clear YES (with evidence) reopens the multiplicity primitive admission request (source_count-family); a clear NO closes it for this baseline generation. Until then, multiplicity stays NOT_ADMITTED.
counterfactuals.evidence_so_far: H07 (single blind case) motivated the composition contract; no counterfactual evidence yet.
